VFDroneStationEncy:
The drone station can be used to remotely connect to and pilot any nearby drone vehicle. The drone station enhances radio technology to keep users safe from distant threats.
 - Connection Range: ~600 meters
 - Designed for: Compartments and Submarines - Can automatically return drones to itself
